title: El Centro and KU partner on data-driven statewide effort to build a fuller picture of Latino communities in Kansas
summary_en: El Centro, a Latino-led, Latino-serving nonprofit organization based in Kansas City, Kansas, is leading an initiative to create a comprehensive, community-led portrait of the Latino experience in Kansas with the KU Center for Community Health and Development.
title_cn: El Centro and KU partner on data-driven statewide effort to build a fuller picture of Latino communities in Kansas

title: KU School of Music to present annual Vespers concerts on Dec. 6
summary_en: The University of Kansas School of Music will present its annual Vespers concerts Dec. 6, with performances at 2:30 p.m. and 7:30 p.m. at the Lied Center of Kansas. Tickets are now available.
title_cn: KU School of Music to present annual Vespers concerts on Dec. 6

title: KU evolutionary genetics researcher wins Big 12 Faculty of the Year Award
summary_en: John Kelly, professor of ecology & evolutionary biology, has been recognized as KU’s Big 12 Faculty of the Year recipient. His research helps explain why genetic diversity persists and demonstrates evolution in real time.
title_cn: KU evolutionary genetics researcher wins Big 12 Faculty of the Year Award
